scope: low-energy muscle strain or minor back soreness with preserved sensation and no neurologic or systemic red flag
patterns: I pulled a muscle lifting a box
my back is sore after gardening
mild lower back pain after lifting
my neck feels tight after sleeping oddly
response: Protect the area and take a break from what caused the pain. A cold pack wrapped to protect the skin, gentle compression if comfortable, and short periods of rest may help early on. Ease back to gentle movement as pain settles; do not push through worsening pain.
red_flags: severe pain, deformity, or inability to use the limb
numbness, weakness, a cold or blue limb
back pain with new bowel or bladder problems, saddle-area numbness, or leg weakness
fever, night pain, or unexplained weight loss
pain that keeps getting worse over days
